events.title: Lebanon becomes first Middle East country to end death penalty
events.description: Lebanon’s parliament voted on Tuesday to abolish the death penalty, making the country the first in the Middle East to do so. Lebanon has not carried out an execution since 2004, but death sentences have continued to be handed down, with the latest issued on Monday. Amnesty International says at least 85 people were still on death row as of January this year. Capital punishment in Lebanon has typically applied to serious crimes including murder, terrorism and espionage. France 24 correspondent Renée Davis reports the latest from Beirut.

The Palestinian Islamist movement had agreed to gradually give up weapons in exchange for an Israeli withdrawal from Gaza, but agreeing on the definition of "disarmament" may prove a sticking point.

events.title: Putin sends Trump a gift - and will hope for something in return
events.description: When Russia releases an American citizen from prison, the US normally hands someone over in return.

events.title: Messi raises 'serious doubts' over his footballing future in touching tribute to father
events.description: Lionel Messi has raised "serious doubts" over his footballing future in a touching tribute to his father, Jorge, who died last week.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Messi raises 'serious doubts' over his footballing future in touching tribute to father

events.title: Man airlifted to hospital after 'shark bite' off Irish coast
events.description: A man has been airlifted to hospital after a suspected shark bite off the Irish coast.

events.title: Japan's Crown Prince Akishino has 'mixed feelings' about male-only succession law
events.description: Japanese Crown Prince says he has “mixed feelings” about the government’s revision to the Imperial House Law that insists only men can become emperor

events.title: A punishing European drought shrivels crops from Dutch potatoes to Bosnian corn
events.description: A drought that is slamming Europe this summer is hitting farmers across Europe hard

events.title: Zambians cast ballots in a presidential election that tests incumbent's economic reforms
events.description: Zambians have begun casting their votes in a presidential election that will test whether President Hakainde Hichilema’s economic reforms were enough to overcome widespread frustration over the cost of living

events.title: Britain to swelter again as it looks poised for a record hot summer
events.description: Large parts of Europe will be sweltering once again, with Britain poised for its fifth heat wave of an exceptional summer that is expected to be the hottest on record

events.title: Ecuador's police seize a cocaine shipment with stickers of Norway's soccer star Erling Haaland
events.description: Police in Ecuador have seized a cocaine shipment featuring soccer star Erling Haaland's face on the packaging

events.title: Officials say US forces on track to complete Iraq pullout by Sept. 30
events.description: The U.S. military is on track to pull all its forces out of Iraq by the end of September, marking the end of a presence that started in 2003

events.title: Mini-Mozart heist blights anniversary tribute as thieves make off with 210 statuettes
events.description: More than 200 gold statuettes of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart have disappeared from Salzburg, officials said Wednesday

events.title: South Africa seeks reimbursement from African countries for migrant repatriations
events.description: South Africa is asking several African governments to reimburse it for repatriating over 80,000 immigrants

events.title: Youth advocates gather in New York to launch new AI standards
events.description: As artificial intelligence (AI) rapidly transforms everything from how we learn, to the job market, children are adopting the technology more than three times faster than adults – exposing them to unique opportunities and risks.

events.title: Convicted rapist who preyed on women at America's top party school faces reckoning after courthouse dash
events.description: Arian Eteghaei received 30 years to life for forcible rape and sexual assault of multiple victims while a student at UC Santa Barbara, then fled custody.

events.title: ICE asks Kentucky officials to hold previously deported man charged with rape while working as landlord
events.description: ICE lodged an immigration detainer in Louisville after Rolando Cenobio Vasquez was charged with rape and human trafficking of a 15-year-old girl.

events.title: U-Haul worker allegedly shoots co-worker dead after argument during shift: Police
events.description: Devin Rice allegedly shot co-worker Fredrick Lytton multiple times during an argument over a drink at a Nashville U-Haul location, police say.

events.title: Man kills wife and 7-year-old daughter before taking own life at Minnesota home daycare; fourth victim found
events.description: Hopkins Police Chief Brent Johnson said three people, including a child, were found dead inside a daycare after officers responded to a domestic call. Another person was found dead in a nearby home.

events.title: NJ woman found with multiple stab wounds at home in affluent county, husband arrested
events.description: A 46-year-old woman was found brutally stabbed in her Somerville home in New Jersey. Her husband has been arrested and charged with murder.

events.title: New power axis in the making? Three military heavyweights lock arms, complicating Abraham Accords strategy
events.description: The Mecca Joint Defence Agreement signed by Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan raises questions about whether it signals a Middle East shift from the U.S.

events.title: North Korea launches another ballistic missile as US, South Korea prepare for military drills
events.description: North Korea's second ballistic missile launch in less than a week comes as the U.S. and South Korea prepare for Ulchi Freedom Shield exercises.
events.ticker_label: 🪖 North Korea launches another ballistic missile as US, South Korea prepare for military drills

events.title: Taliban wipes out decades of progress as 2.4M Afghan girls remain locked out of school, UN agency says
events.description: UNESCO says 2.4 million Afghan girls are locked out of secondary school five years after the Taliban banned female education beyond the primary level.

events.title: Israel vindicated by Gaza nutrition data after ‘blood libel’ starvation claims, UN envoy says
events.description: A United Nations-backed survey found no widespread acute malnutrition in Gaza, prompting Israel's ambassador to call prior famine claims a blood libel.

events.title: Netanyahu rejects Board of Peace's Gaza plan: No 'withdrawal until Hamas is genuinely disarmed'
events.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejects the Board of Peace's 15-point Gaza proposal, demanding Hamas surrender all weapons before any withdrawal.
